items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This is a utility class that computes the bounding box of a polygon as a rectangle
defined by the lower left and upper right point.
items.translation: 这是一个工具类，用于计算多边形的边界框，该边界框由左下角和右上角点定义的矩形表示。

items.source:
A marker interface that indicates a literal replacement in a query instead of a
parameter replacement.
items.translation: 一个标记接口，用于指示在查询中进行字面替换而非参数替换。

items.source: Annotation to provide Cypher statements that will be used for executing the method.
items.translation: 注释，用于提供将用于执行该方法的 Cypher 语句。

items.source: Collects the parts of a Cypher query to be handed over to the Cypher generator.
items.translation: 收集要传递给 Cypher 生成器的 Cypher 查询的各个部分。
已收集向量搜索的参数。
